out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The 2026 food permit was not posted
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO POST THE FOOD PERMIT. CORRECT BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Observed no Employee Health Policy in place.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. EHS PROVIDED OWNERSHIP WITH FAIRFAX COUNTY EMPLOYEE ILLNESS AGREEMENT IN ENGLISH AND SPANISH. OWNERSHIP HAD ALL STAFF READ AND SIGN A COPY. RETAIN ON SITE FOR FUTURE INSPECTIONS.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS PROVIDED OWNERSHIP WITH FAIRFAX COUNTY’S VOMIT AND DIARRHEA CLEAN UP PROCEDURES. RETAIN ON SITE FOR FUTURE INSPECTIONS. BANH MI SAIGONESE (Inspection Date: 09/04/2026) Page 2 of 4

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: Observed staff wash his gloved hands in the hand sink
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO TAKE OFF GLOVES AND WASH HIS HANDS. STAFF REMOVED GLOVES AND WASHED HIS HANDS. SEE WHEN TO WASH FACT SHEET.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed staff using the handsinks to wash wet wiping cloths.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO WASH CLOTHS IN THE 3-COMPARTMENT SINK. THE HAND SINK IS FOR HAND WASHING ONLY.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Hand washing signs were not observed posted at the hand sinks
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH TWO HAND SIGNS TO POST AT THE HAND SINKS. BANH MI SAIGONESE (Inspection Date: 09/04/2026) Page 3 of 4

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in a crock pot: grilled pork was observed at 92f. Pork was grilled less than 1hr prior to inspection 2) at ambient temperature on top of the glass display cooler: Vietnamese ham was observed at 90f. Vietnamese ham wrapped in banana leaves was observed at 106f. Upon discussion with PIC, ham was cooked 1hr prior to inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC INSTRUCTED STAFF TO REHEAT GRILLED PORK ON THE GRILL TO 165f. PIC MOVED ALL OF THE HAM TO THE FREEZER TO RAPIDLY CHILL TO 41f.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: Observed no date marking system on site.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO DATE MARK ALL FOODS THAT ARE TO BE STORED FOR MORE THAN 24 HOURS. SEE DATE MARKING HAND OUT.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: 1) Vietnamese mayonnaise Upon discussion with PIC, Vietnamese mayonnaise uses Raw shelled eggs
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. EHS INSTRUCTED OWNERSHIP TO UPDATE THE DIGITAL MENU TO INDICATE THE MAYO CONTAINS RAW SHELLED EGGS. INCLUDE AN ASTERISK NEXT TO THE MENU ITEM AND INCLUDE A DISCLOSURE STATEMENT AT THE BOTTOM. PIC UPDATED THE MENU WITH THE APPROPRIATE CONSUMER ADVISORIES.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed beverages, dry storage ingredients, and pickled vegetables being stored directly on the floor.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. ELEVATE ALL FOOD OFF THE FLOOR TO FACILITATE PROPER CLEANING. CORRECT BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Observed multiple staff members not wear a hair restraint
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff. PIC INSTRUCTED STAFF TO PUT ON HAIR NETS

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Durable Materials
violations.observation: Plastic take out bags were observed being used to store food in the coolers and freezers.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be resistant to pitting, chipping, crazing, scratching, scoring, distortion, and decomposition. DISCONTINUE USING THE PLASTIC TAKE OUT BAGS TO STORE FOOD. USE NSF APPROVED OR FOOD GRADE REUSABLE CONTAINERS. CORRECT BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not designed or constructed to be easily cleanable: 1) wooden pallet
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces shall be free of unnecessary ledges, projections, and crevices, and designed and constructed to allow easy cleaning and to facilitate maintenance. REMOVE WOODEN PALLET. CORRECT BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed a missing panel over the steamer and a hole above the 3-compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. REPLACE PANEL AND REPAIR HOLE TO PREVENT PESTS FROM ENTERING. CORRECT BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.
